function.name: done
function.arguments: {"summary": "Picked up the red block from the table at about (-0.11,-0.05) after three grasp attempts and transferred it toward the bowl, but the gripper opened during the final transfer and the block dropped onto the table next to the bowl instead of inside it. Final state: block resting on the table near the bowl; task not completed.", "hindsight": "On this rig a gripper measurement near 0.016 means the pads are pressing on the block (holding); it does NOT mean an empty close, and 0.98 means open. Closing with pads at the block top height ejects the block; close at z=0.804-0.813 (table z=0.80, block top ~0.82). Wrist camera (yaw=0): image up = world +x, image right = world -y. The bowl is near (0.09, 0.0) and the block starts near (-0.10,-0.05). Motion windows per submit vary between ~2 and ~80 control steps regardless of polling, so fold gripper open/close into transfer commands and re-issue truncated moves. Opening the gripper mid-transfer releases the block early: the fingers open faster than the arm crosses the last centimeters, so release only after the TCP is vertically over the bowl."}
